art_direction: Premium warm stylized 3D environment concept art. Emerald/forest greens, ocean blues, selective warm gold. Mood: wonder, kindness, ecological care, curiosity, peaceful optimism. Floating island archipelago world.
notes: Original designs only. No text/UI/watermarks. Consistent style targeted. Actual pixel dimensions and byte sizes must be verified after export. No paid services used.

assets.subject: Panoramic floating/island archipelago linked by winding natural stone paths and sparkling waterways, forested islands, distant observatory mountain and lighthouse, one clear focal island, atmospheric depth. No people or text.
Serene forest sanctuary with a huge old tree, luminous leaves used sparingly, mossy stones, small stream, sunbeams, and a welcoming path.
Friendly high mountain observatory on a rounded summit, elegant stone-and-wood structure, layered blue mountains and clouds, sunrise glow, safe inviting path.
Welcoming small eco-village of original rounded timber-and-stone cottages, gardens, flowering plants, a communal square, warm windows, integrated into the island landscape.
Clear winding river splitting into a small delta, stepping stones, reeds, native flowers, wetland plants and visible healthy biodiversity, calm water highlights.
Distinctive friendly lighthouse on a green rocky headland, elegant cream stone and deep teal details, warm golden beacon glow, ocean cliffs and distant islands.

limitations: Images generated via Grok Imagine. Actual file export, optimization, and byte-size verification still required before final commit of binary assets.
Style consistency is intended; final visual QA of the full pack is recommended before QD-002 integration.
